source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of energy stored in a capacitor (PDF 74-76).

blocks.text: Capacitor ko charge ke saath saath bijli ki tawanai jama karne ka aala bhi samjha ja sakta hai. Plates ka charge bijli ki potential energy rakhta hai, kyunke plates par charge rakhne ke liye kaam karna parta hai. Achha saboot discharge se milta hai: agar charged capacitor ki plates moti taar se jori jayein to charge aik plate se doosri par behta aur taar garam ho jati hai. Yeh hararat charged capacitor mein jama tawanai se aayi hogi.

Kyunke Q, V ke mutanasib hai, V ke muqable Q ka graph origin se guzarti seedhi lakeer hai (Fig 16.10). Charge ka har chhota izafa potential difference barhata hai, is liye agla izafa lane ke liye zyada kaam chahiye. Graph ke neeche raqbe ko dQ chaurai ki patli pattiyon mein baantein. Chhota charge dQ, V1 potential difference se guzarne ka kaam dW = (dQ)(V1) (16.38) hai, jo aik patti ke raqbe ke barabar hai. Capacitor ko Q tak charge karne ka kul kaam tamam pattiyon ka jor, tikon OAB ka raqba hai: (1/2)(OA)(AB) = (1/2) QV. Yun charged capacitor mein jama tawanai W = (1/2) QV (16.39), aur Q = CV se W = (1/2) CV^2 (16.40).

blocks.alt: V aur Q ka graph: origin O se B tak seedhi gulabi lakeer, B Q-mehwar ke nuqte A ke oopar. Lakeer ke neeche delta Q chaurai ke das patle mustateel seerhi banate hain; V1 satah wala aik mustateel lakeerdaar (hatched). Nuqta-daar lakeerein V-mehwar par V1 aur aakhri potential V dikhati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.10: Charge hote capacitor ka V-Q graph (kitab mein Fig. 16.15 chhapa; kitab ki figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab is graph par 'Fig. 16.15' likhti hai jabke matan Fig 16.10 kehta hai, aur ufqi mehwar ke neeche 'time' bhi chhapa hai. Yeh mehwar waqt nahi, charge Q hai. Har patla mustateel delta Q charge ko V1 potential par le jane ka kaam (delta Q)(V1) hai; sab ka jor tikon OAB ka raqba hai, yani W = (1/2)QV.

Tawanai ko plates ke darmiyan electric field mein jama bhi samjha ja sakta hai. V = Ed aur C = A eo er / d rakhne se tawanai = (1/2)(A eo er / d)(Ed)^2 = (1/2) eo er E^2 (Ad), jahan Ad plates ke darmiyan hajm hai. Is liye energy density (fi ikai hajm tawanai) (1/2) eo er E^2 (16.42) hai, jo har electric field ke liye durust hai.

4 uF aur 8 uF ke capacitors series mein jore aur 100 V supply se charge kiye jate hain. Kul charge aur jama tawanai maloom karein. Hal: 1/Ce = 1/4 + 1/8 = 3/8, is liye Ce = (8/3) uF. Q = Ce V = (8/3 x 10^-6 F)(100 V) = 2.67 x 10^-4 C. W = (1/2) QV = (1/2)(2.67 x 10^-4 C)(100 V) = 1.33 x 10^-2 J.

blocks.title: Kitab mein Misal 16.7
blocks.text: Sawal 100 V supply batata hai, lekin kitab ka hal 120 V use karta hai aur Q = 3.2 x 10^-4 C aur W = 1.92 x 10^-2 J deta hai. Bataye gaye 100 V se jawab Q = 2.67 x 10^-4 C aur W = 1.33 x 10^-2 J hain, jaisa oopar. Jaanch ke liye nishan zada.

16 uF capacitor 100 V tak charge kiya jata hai. Jama tawanai maloom karein. Agar potential difference dugna kar diya jaye to tawanai kitne guna barhegi? Hal: W = (1/2) CV^2 = (1/2)(16 x 10^-6 F)(100 V)^2 = 8 x 10^-2 J. Tawanai V^2 par munhasir hai, is liye V dugna karne par tawanai 2^2 = 4 guna barhti hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 uF capacitor 4000 V tak charge hai. Yeh kitni tawanai jama karta hai?

items: Tawanai = V-Q graph ke neeche raqba.
Field mein energy density: (1/2) eo er E^2.
